title: A category change still mirrors to the catalog and every location
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Use the staging site with the Tiered Pricing release (and the Tiered Pricing QA site too, once it exists); production is not needed.
  • Use a client with two locations, location 1 and location 2, both stocking a new inventory part made for this test, part A, in category A.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, so part A starts in it.
  • Have a new category for this test, category B.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. At location 1, open part A in the inventory.
  2. Pick category B as part A's category.
  3. Save the part.
  4. Open part A in the catalog.
  5. Switch to location 2.
  6. Open part A in the inventory.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Part A's dialog opens in category A.

Step 2:

  • Category B is picked.

Step 3:

  • Part A saves in category B.

Step 4:

  • The catalog shows part A in category B.

Step 5:

  • Location 2 is the current location.

Step 6:

  • At location 2 part A's category also reads category B.
  • Its sell price is recalculated from category B's matrix, as it has no fixed price.
